question: Could you assess the relationship between the poverty rates from the previous year's census data and the percentage of births without maternal morbidity for the years 2016 to 2018? Use only data for births where no maternal morbidity was reported and for each year, use the 5-year census data from the year before to compute the Pearson correlation coefficient
sql:
WITH morbidity_data AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) AS year,
    County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_Desc = 'None checked' THEN Births ELSE 0 END) AS no_morbidity_births,
    SUM(Births) AS total_births
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) IN (2016, 2017, 2018)
  GROUP BY year, County_of_Residence_FIPS
),
pct_no_morbidity AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(no_morbidity_births, total_births) AS pct_no_morbidity
  FROM morbidity_data
  WHERE total_births > 0
),
joined_2016 AS (
  SELECT 
    2016 AS year,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(c.poverty, c.pop_determined_poverty_status) AS poverty_rate,
    p.pct_no_morbidity
  FROM pct_no_morbidity p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr` c
    ON CAST(c.geo_id AS STRING) = p.County_of_Residence_FIPS
  WHERE p.year = 2016
    AND c.pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
joined_2017 AS (
  SELECT 
    2017 AS year,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(c.poverty, c.pop_determined_poverty_status) AS poverty_rate,
    p.pct_no_morbidity
  FROM pct_no_morbidity p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr` c
    ON CAST(c.geo_id AS STRING) = p.County_of_Residence_FIPS
  WHERE p.year = 2017
    AND c.pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
joined_2018 AS (
  SELECT 
    2018 AS year,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(c.poverty, c.pop_determined_poverty_status) AS poverty_rate,
    p.pct_no_morbidity
  FROM pct_no_morbidity p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr` c
    ON CAST(c.geo_id AS STRING) = p.County_of_Residence_FIPS
  WHERE p.year = 2018
    AND c.pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
all_data AS (
  SELECT * FROM joined_2016
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM joined_2017
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM joined_2018
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    COUNT(*) AS n,
    AVG(poverty_rate) AS avg_x,
    AVG(pct_no_morbidity) AS avg_y,
    AVG(poverty_rate * pct_no_morbidity) AS avg_xy,
    AVG(POW(poverty_rate, 2)) AS avg_x2,
    AVG(POW(pct_no_morbidity, 2)) AS avg_y2
  FROM all_data
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
  year,
  n,
  (n * avg_xy - avg_x * avg_y) / 
    SQRT((n * avg_x2 - avg_x * avg_x) * (n * avg_y2 - avg_y * avg_y)) AS pearson_r
FROM stats
ORDER BY year
